second_seed_rule: Run the second predeclared development seed only if the first meets the full paired gate. Otherwise close the protocol with its saved evidence.

target.rule: Compute the correction from the actual saved decision state, then add the frozen waveform to original applied requests while preserving raw policy history. Project only baseline-legal requests and preserve preexisting out-of-range requests. Never change qpos or velocity directly.

required_preflight: Freeze the same immutable weighted actor for all three branches
Restore exact live release state including both RNG streams, contact state and actuator history
Read back native contact and foot-support timing at the exact decision boundary
Verify zero modification of requested actor outputs and first delayed motor commands
Verify actual CUDA startup, Windows observation and full 11 s first-episode camera
